data.name: Gadmon
data.gender_notes: Gadmon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words gad (troop) and mon (mountain). In the Bible, Gad is one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Gadmon can be interpreted as 'God's mountain troop'. The name Gadmon carries the meaning “God's mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gadmon usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and protection from God.
data.etymology: Gadmon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gadmon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
